context_prerequisites: an explicit harvest action is required
counterexamples: a quantity or crop word alone is not a harvest action

context_prerequisites: an explicit trimming action is required
counterexamples: a noisy STT spelling of a body part is not a new task

context_prerequisites: an explicit sorting or separating action is required
counterexamples: putting items in a container is not sorting

semantic_candidates: move onions to an explicit destination
context_prerequisites: explicit movement action and explicit destination
counterexamples: putting an item into a container alone does not prove transport

context_prerequisites: an explicit picking or harvest action is required
counterexamples: a strawberry word alone is not a harvest action

context_prerequisites: an explicit sorting or separating action is required
counterexamples: putting items in a container is not sorting

semantic_candidates: inspect strawberries for spoilage or condition
context_prerequisites: an explicit inspection or checking action is required
counterexamples: a safety or quality concern without an inspection action is not a step

semantic_candidates: put strawberries into packaging or pack them
context_prerequisites: an explicit packing or placing-in-packaging action is required
counterexamples: packing does not imply transport to another destination

context_prerequisites: endings do not create a task by themselves
counterexamples: an auxiliary or directive ending alone is not an executable step

semantic_candidates: quantity unit followed by a separate action stem
context_prerequisites: keep a quantity unit separate from an adjacent action; preserve both meanings when supported
counterexamples: do not merge a unit with an adjacent action stem into one unit

context_prerequisites: number + 번 with 밭 is location context, not a quantity; quantity still needs an explicit unit
counterexamples: do not parse 2번 밭 as quantity 2번

context_prerequisites: ask a blocking quantity clarification and keep quantity null or UNSPECIFIED
counterexamples: do not mark READY with a guessed quantity

semantic_candidates: deictic location preserved for on-site understanding
context_prerequisites: preserve raw deictic location with canonical_name null; a deictic expression alone permits execution with a non-blocking on-site advisory; block only an explicit location conflict
counterexamples: do not invent a canonical destination from a deictic expression

semantic_candidates: named field, storage, sorting, or greenhouse location
context_prerequisites: preserve the named location as stated; it may serve as a movement destination
counterexamples: a named location alone does not prove transport or another action

context_prerequisites: preserve direction as location context; do not invent a named destination
counterexamples: a direction does not prove transport without an explicit movement action

context_prerequisites: use sequence words to order explicit actions only
counterexamples: a sequence cue or connective does not create a task by itself
